div.div: Which is the point of the order: by the time you reach I, both contracts are mostly transcription. Designing an API before you know what data crosses the boundary is where the guessing happens.

div.div: Name both. A candidate who only specifies the network contract has described a backend feature with a UI attached; the props and callbacks between your own components are the frontend design.
